description.summary: the state of a window, and the shell's actions on it

protocol.description:
The state of a window the ext-foreign-toplevel-list protocol lists, and the actions the shell takes on it: activate, minimise, restore and close. Reading and acting are two globals, the manager and the actions, so that a client trusted to read every window's state need not be trusted to act on them. The compositor offers each only to the clients it trusts with it; it is Athanor's own protocol (doc_own_stack.md OS5, decision 19).
A new version adds interfaces, requests, events or enum entries; a client binds the version it knows.

interface.name: athanor_toplevel_manager_v1
interface.description: Makes the state object of a window. It acts on nothing: the actions are athanor_toplevel_actions_v1's.

entry.name: already_made
entry.summary: the client already has a state object of this window

request.name: destroy
request.description: The state objects made from the manager stay valid.

request.name: get_toplevel_state
request.description:
Makes the state object of a window. Its current state, the outputs it is on that the client has bound, and a done event are sent at once, then each change followed by done. An output the client binds later is sent with output_enter then.
On a closed handle the object is inert: it sends nothing. A second state object of the same window, while the client holds the first, is the already_made error.

interface.name: athanor_toplevel_actions_v1
interface.description:
Activates, minimises, restores and closes windows.
An action on a closed or unknown handle, on a window that is not mapped or has not drawn, while the session is locked, or while it is paused on another virtual terminal, does nothing.

request.name: activate
request.description: Raises the window, restoring it when it is minimised, and gives it the seat's keyboard unless a surface holds the keyboard exclusively.

request.name: set_minimized
request.description: Hides the window until it is restored or activated.

request.name: unset_minimized
request.description: Shows a minimised window where it was, and gives it the keyboard.

request.name: close
request.description: Sends the window's client the request to close it; the client decides.

interface.name: athanor_toplevel_state_v1
interface.description: Events describe the window's state and outputs. They are applied together at done.

entry.name: activated
entry.summary: the window is the active one; while a layer surface or the lock holds the keyboard it keeps this state

event.name: state
event.description: Every flag that holds; a flag absent no longer holds.

description.summary: the window is on an output
the window is no longer on an output
the events since the last done apply
